features.title: Everything you need to run your life as a system
features.description: Designed for depth without ceremony — each feature answers a concrete question about your progress.

items.title: Pillars
items.description: Organize your life into areas that matter — Health, Engineering, Relationships, and anything else you define.

items.title: Flexible habits
items.description: Track habits daily, on specific weekdays, or a target number of times per week or month.

items.title: Progress & streaks
items.description: See completion rates, current and best streaks, and how your consistency evolves over time.

items.title: Goals
items.description: Set goals, link supporting habits to them, and watch progress update as you complete your routines.

items.title: Insights
items.description: Understand which pillar needs focus this week and how consistent your daily effort really is.

items.title: Journal
items.description: Log mood, energy and sleep, and review your monthly state alongside your habit data.

technology.title: Modern, boring, dependable

project.title: A personal project, built in the open
project.description: LifeOS started as a way for one person to systematically improve their life — and the code is available for anyone to learn from or build on.
project.philosophy: The philosophy is simple: track what you do, understand what works, and improve one thing at a time. No aggressive marketing, no gamified streaks — just a clearer picture of your own life.
